## Checklist
- [ ] Branch follows convention: `<name>/<feature>` (e.g., `sarthak/backend-api`, `vidhaath/ui-frontend`)
- [ ] Targeted branch is `main` (no direct pushes to `main`)
- [ ] Code has been tested locally (frontend / backend / engine tests pass)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or `.env` files are included
- [ ] Documentation has been updated if applicable
